chunks: And they say: "Ah woe! This is the Day of Reckoning."

key_terms.يَا وَيْلَنَا: Ah woe to us / Exclamation of despair

ai.seo_question: What do the disbelievers say when they see their deeds laid out on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mutaffifin (often cited in contexts of the Day of Judgment) highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers when the barriers of worldly excuses are removed. It underscores the concept of 'Yaum al-Din' as the ultimate settlement of accounts, where the delay in divine punishment is no longer a sign of neglect but a prelude to inevitable reckoning. This moment marks the transition from the realm of choice to the realm of consequence, a theme central to Shia eschatology regarding the finality of the Hereafter.
